# technitium_permissions_logs (Resource)

Manages who may view, modify and delete in the Logs section. The lists set here are the section's full lists: users and groups left out lose their rights, except the built-in admin groups, which the server always keeps; list those too, or take them from the data source of the same name. Destroying the resource leaves the permissions as they are.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of groups, including the built-in admin groups the server keeps. Leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_permissions))
- `user_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of individual users. An empty set removes them; leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--group_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_permissions`

Required:

- `can_delete` (Boolean) May delete in the section.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) May change the section.
- `can_view` (Boolean) May view the section.
- `name` (String) The group name.


<a id="nestedatt--user_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_permissions`

Required:

- `can_delete` (Boolean) May delete in the section.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) May change the section.
- `can_view` (Boolean) May view the section.
- `username` (String) The username.
